messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Change the video's camera setup to an upper-body shot from the front. Use the provided reference image to determine the viewing direction, subject placement, and framing at the start of the edited video. Follow the camera setup and movement described above, and preserve the timing and progression of the action in the source video. Keep the person's identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, action, and scene unchanged.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Please return to video 0 and make the following change to that video: Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: I'd like to change the video's camera setup to an upper-body shot from the front. Keep the person's identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, action, and scene unchanged. Use the provided reference image to determine the viewing direction, subject placement, and framing at the start of the edited video. Follow the camera setup and movement described above, and preserve the timing and progression of the action in the source video.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"He stands still, then briefly turns his head to the side, bends forward to cough into his hand, and then straightens back up to face the camera.","camera":"The camera is static in a medium shot, framing the man from the waist up.","clothing":"He wears a white tank top with a large pink and black palm tree graphic and the text 'Los Angeles' on the front.","hair_color":"His hair is dark brown or black.","hairstyle":"He has short, dark hair styled upward in a small quiff.","identity":"A young Black man with a slim build and short facial hair stands facing the camera.","scene":"The setting is a futuristic, neon-lit environment with a large glowing circular structure behind him and a wet, reflective floor."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The output reframes the same man from a closer chest-up view to a wider front medium shot showing him from roughly the waist up, matching the reference framing and centered placement. The same standing, head turn, forward bend/cough, and recovery sequence is preserved, and the futuristic neon scene remains consistent.
arguments.requested_change: Change the camera to a front upper-body shot, using the reference image for initial viewing direction, subject placement, and framing, while preserving the person, clothing, action, timing, and scene.
uncertain: Whether the added tank-top graphic is an unintended clothing change or a difference in the actual source video not visible in the provided frames.
unexpected_changes: The tank top now clearly shows a large palm-tree graphic and 'Los Angeles' text, which was not visible in the provided source frames.
